titre: Devoir de contrôle n°1 - Anglais (9ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
My name is Sami and I am fourteen years old. I live in Sousse, a beautiful coastal city in Tunisia. Every morning, I wake up at six o'clock and help my mother prepare breakfast before going to school. My favourite subject is English because I love watching films and reading stories in this language. After school, I usually play football with my friends in the park. At the weekend, my family and I go to the beach or visit my grandparents in the countryside. I dream of becoming a doctor one day, so I study hard every evening.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) Where does Sami live?   (2 marks)
2) What does Sami do before going to school?   (2 marks)
3) Why does he like English?   (2 marks)
4) What does Sami want to become in the future?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verb in brackets in the correct tense: Every morning, Sami (wake) ______ up at six o'clock.   (1,5 marks)
2) Give the plural of: story ______ ; child ______.   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with the right word (because / but / and): I study hard ______ I want to be a doctor.   (1,5 marks)
4) Find in the text a word that means: "the sport played with a ball and the feet" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Write a short paragraph (about 8 lines) about your daily routine. Use the present simple and time expressions (in the morning, after school, at the weekend…).
